title: Bad Bunny Plays the Netherlands for the First Time — Two Nights at GelreDome, Arnhem
detail: Bad Bunny performs two sold-out nights at GelreDome in Arnhem (June 23–24, 2026) — his first-ever shows in the Netherlands — continuing the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour after Düsseldorf. 'La Difícil' and '200 MPH' serve as the nights' exclusive songs.
